== Overview == 
Mastery is a long-term progression system where you can complete milestones across [[Locations]], [[Treasure Map]]s, [[Sluices]], and [[Equipment]] Crafting to earn permanent luck, faster sluice speeds, improved crafting stats, and higher map spawn rates. As you advance, you can also unlock unique [[Titles|titles]] that showcase your experience and progression. 

== Location Mastery ==
The luck boost '''does not stack'''. You only receive the multiplier for the highest level completed.
